title: Seer Confirms Receipt of Unsolicited Proposal and Director Candidate Nominations from Radoff-JEC Group
summary: Seer, Inc. disclosed receipt of an unsolicited, non-binding acquisition proposal and director candidate nominations from activist investor Bradley L. Radoff, Michael Torok, and their affiliates via a Form 8-K filed on April 13, 2026. The filing references an attached press release but does not disclose the terms or valuation of the proposal. This is a company-specific corporate event with no relevance to broad market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Seer, Inc. (NASDAQ: SEER) filed Form 8-K on April 13, 2026 disclosing receipt of a highly contingent, non-binding, and unsolicited acquisition proposal
The proposal was submitted by Bradley L. Radoff, Michael Torok, and certain of their affiliates (Radoff-JEC Group)
The filing also discloses director candidate nominations from the same group
Signed by David Horn, President and CFO
The 8-K references Exhibit 99.1 (press release) but the content of the proposal terms is not included in this filing
